in_hebrew.name: צָרַד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root צרד (tsarad) meaning to scorch, burn, or blaze. The name Zared may refer to someone who is shining or brilliant, or it could be a reference to someone who is scorching or burning with passion or anger.

in_greek.name: Ζάρεδ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root ζάρ (zar) meaning to shine or glow. The name Zared may refer to someone who is shining or radiant, or it could be a reference to the shining or radiant aspect of a deity or other spiritual being.

in_latin.name: Zaredus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root zar meaning shining or radiant. The name Zared may refer to someone who is shining or radiant, or it could be a reference to the shining or radiant aspect of a deity or other spiritual being.
